finding: Runtime admission flag is added to generator metadata but is absent from native evidence returned by check_physical_ast; SQL pairing could therefore skip the required runtime evidence.
source_trace: native_verify.run_generated copies selected metadata fields only and merges check_physical_ast output into records.
quality_pairing.pair_quality_records gates additional admission only when the evidence record carries additional_ir_admission_required.
Q15 explicitly publishes that flag from its physical oracle; the proposed Q01 change does not.
required_fix: Publish the flag from both Q01 physical oracles and test propagation through the actual native-record construction and pairing path.
